> **This is NOT a UFS-logic fault.** UFS is only the *exposer*: a heavy-I/O, line-based (level-triggered)
> interrupt device that loads the P2SB sideband enough to trip a P2SB PCIe-ordering bug. The fault is in
> the P2SB bridge. Do not chase UFS link/PHY/protocol — the UFS `IS_` is clean apart from a normal completion.

## 1. Identity & classification
- **ID:** 16030172470 · **Title:** [HP][Quanta][WCL][Cheddar] 0x9F BSOD on WinPVT Hibernation_Test (UFS-only) → **[P2SB] EOI bypassing MSI CPL**
- **Program / release:** WCL (Wildcat Lake), `package.wclc-n204-a1`, stepping **A1** · also **PTL affected** `[confirmed: BEAT]`
- **Component:** `hw.fabric` · **Owner:** msure · **Submitted:** 2026-03-26 · **Tags:** customer, CMF
- **Status:** HSD field `root_caused / awaiting_fix`; **OS mitigation shipped in 25H2'7D**; WCL HW BugEco `16030673570` **rejected** → treat **OS workaround as the resolution on WCL**. `[confirmed]`
- **Signature:** `ufs-p2sb-eoi-rirr-race-on-line-irq` (interrupt-ordering / fabric class)
- **Layer:** P2SB sideband bridge ↔ IOAPIC/ITSS ↔ CPU LAPIC; UFS host controller is the I/O load that exposes it
- **Scope:** one bug across **8 linked tickets in ≥6 teams** (sighting, platform bug, SoC bugeco, IP bugeco×3, errata, AR) — this record consolidates them (see §10)

## 2. Symptom (observable) + reproducibility profile
- **Bugcheck `0x9F` (DRIVER_POWER_STATE_FAILURE)** on a **UFS-only** system during **S4 hibernate resume** and **warm-reset cycling**; requires a reboot to recover. `[confirmed: BEAT, comments]`
- Sequence `[confirmed: MSFT debug, Comment 1667478043]`: S4 resume → UFS re-init OK (link-up, gear-neg, NOP-Out, queries via **polling**) → I/O resumes, a burst of R/W completes for a few ms → **interrupts stop being delivered**: HCI completes commands (CNR set, **doorbell cleared**) but the **ISR is never invoked** → **30 s** StorPort `UnitTimeout` → **reset cascade RESET LUN → RESET DEVICE → RESET BUS** → reset recovery (via polling) **succeeds** → same failure **repeats immediately** → **IOAPIC RIRR remains stuck** → loop repeats until bugcheck.
- **Red herring:** PA shows a **NAC BAD** response before recovery, but **NAC is not fatal** and should not start recovery; UFS transactions otherwise clean. `[confirmed: Comment 1667478043]`
- **Reproducibility:** within **< 100 cycles** of WR/S4; **x1 SDHC expedites** it; needs **Corp config** (UFS enabled). Field rate ~**1/3 units, 2/30 runs** (Xiaomi P59). `[confirmed: BEAT, Comment 1567187054]`
- **Dumps:** customer uploaded 2 — `9F after change file.zip` (PHY default) and `…S4_-6bd_BSOD_0x9f…MS_private_binary.7z` (PHY **−6 dB**). `[confirmed: Comment 1667391571]`

## 3. Initial triage — first discriminators
- **Rule-in (it IS this)** `[confirmed]`:
  - IOAPIC **`rte_line_25.remote_irr` (RIRR, bit14) = 1 STUCK** with `delivery_status` = 1, `trigger_mode` = 1 (level), `polarity` = 1 (active-low) — the decisive fingerprint.
  - UFS **`IS_` shows ONLY `utrcs` (bit0) = 1**; **all fatal bits (`SBFES`/`HCFES`/`DFES`) = 0** → not a UFS fault.
  - VISA **`servicePCmdValid[3]`→`[0]`** with `itss/msigen/w2sbsm_ps` `0x3→0x5→0x0` → EOI/posted prioritized over MSI completion to ITSS.
  - Repro on **NVL only when the P2SB fix is disabled** via chicken bit `pcd.p2sb0.cfg.p2sbc.ccpeome = 0x1`.
- **Rule-out (it is NOT this)** `[confirmed/inferred]`:
  - If UFS uses **MSI** (not a line-based level IRQ) → not this (MSI doesn't need RIRR).
  - If the UFS `IS_` shows **SBFES/HCFES/DFES** or a link-lost/`DFES` → that's a UFS-side fault, not this.
  - The **NAC-bad** and **UFS PHY equalization** (−6 dB sweep) are **dead ends** — PHY tuning did not fix it.
- **Nearest look-alikes (and the deciding tell):**
  - `16029554884` (HLK Connected-Standby) — same **unit-timeout + LUN/DEVICE/BUS reset-cascade** symptom, but there the root cause is the vendor endpoint-reset recovery gap; **here RIRR is stuck in the IOAPIC** and the UFS link is fine.
  - `16030803619` (`pc:Ab04` S4 hang) — related/open; emerged from the **mis-scoped** (all-IP) WA backport, not the P2SB race itself.

## 4. Reproduction recipe (config, images, IFWI, knobs, operating point)
- WCL (`wclc-n204-a1`, A1) with **UFS as the only storage**; BIOS `00.32`, BKC **WW07**, Win11 **25H2**, µcode `m_c0_d0650_00000007.inc`, Processor ID `0xd0650`, PMC `2100.76.0.1029`. `[confirmed: description]`
- Run **WinPVT Hibernation_Test** (S4 cycling) or **warm-reset cycling** on **Corp config** with UFS enabled; **x1 SDHC** expedites.
- **Expect:** 0x9F within < 100 WR/S4 cycles; does **not** self-recover (next cycle repeats).
- **Confirm it's THIS:** halt and read `rte_line_25` → **RIRR stuck = 1**; UFS `IS_` only `utrcs=1`.
- **Avoid repro / mitigate:** apply the **25H2'7D** OS patch (IOAPIC read before EOI), or switch UFS IRQ to **edge-trigger**.

### 5b. VISA — P2SB/ITSS ordering `[confirmed: Comment 14615454242 snapshots]`
- Signals `servicePCmdValid[3]` (MWr→CrWr master) and `servicePCmdValid[0]` (EOI-conversion master); `itss/msigen/w2sbsm_ps` state `0x3→0x5→0x0`.
- Annotated "Failing Iteration": several **posted** transactions to P2SB while ITSS is generating MSI (`w2sbsm_ps=0x3`); **EOI serviced before the MSI completion** reaches ITSS; ITSS proceeds only after the late MSI completion (`0x5→0x0`).

### 5c. PSF-OBS fabric trace `[confirmed: Comments 1363666535/1363666691 snapshots]`
- Good ISR: Read `UTRLDBR` (off `0x58`) → write doorbell (`0x8000000`/`0x20000`) → UFS uplink MRd64/MWr64 → **MSI from rte_25 IOAPIC** (`P2SB[0x11B0]`) → ISR reads `IS`/`IE`, clears `IS.utrcs`, writes **EOI vector `0x81`** at `0xFEC00040`. UFS MMIO base `0x8013BE80xx`.
- Failing: only ~0.4 s window; **multiple `UTRLDBR` writes before UTP transfer completion**; **EOI issued without clearing IS first**.

### 5d. Interrupt-flow (mechanism) `[confirmed: Comment 1667724964 + BEAT snapshots]`
- **Pass:** `SEND_IOAPIC_INTR cmpl` sets RIRR=1 **before** the Directed-EOI → EOI clears RIRR.
- **Fail:** `SEND_IOAPIC_INTR cmpl` **delayed by P2SB congestion**, arrives **after** the EOI; EOI seen while RIRR=0 → **EOI discarded**; the late completion then sets **RIRR=1 → stuck**.
- **WA:** OS inserts a **`Reg read on IOREGSEL` before the EOI** to fence the late completion so RIRR=1 first.

### 5e. BSOD dump / PA / FTH `[confirmed]`
- WinDbg: 0x9F, reset path `storufs` (LUN/DEVICE/BUS); event logs **500 (Unit Timeout)** + **550 (hierarchical reset)**. PA: NAC-bad, 30 s pre-reset gaps. FTH: StartCpl→CplDone > 5 µs was the capture trigger. Memdumps: `\\gar.corp.intel.com\ec\proj\ba\SIV_OS_Debug\MemDump\WCL\14027442505_WCL_HP_UFS` `[gap: not pulled]`.

### 5f. Decisive-first capture sequence
1. **AT the hang, before reset:** halt, read `rte_line_25` (RIRR) + UFS `IS_` — the two together rule-in/rule-out instantly.
2. **To prove P2SB ordering:** VISA `servicePCmdValid[3]/[0]` + `w2sbsm_ps`.
3. **To localize:** PSF-OBS around the last successful vs failing ISR.
4. **Trap:** a bare `set_eoi` does **not** recover a wedged line — don't conclude from it that EOI "worked".

## 6. Debug flow (diagnostic narrowing)
1. **Dump says UFS I/O timeout + failing link recovery → 0x9F.** Need: is the UFS link actually broken? → PA shows UFS transactions **clean**; NAC-bad is non-fatal. Narrowed: not a UFS data-path/link fault.
2. **If UFS is fine, why do completions stop?** → MSFT live debug: HCI completes (CNR set, doorbell cleared) but **ISR never fires**; **IOAPIC RIRR stuck**. Narrowed: the interrupt line is wedged, not the device.
3. **Why is RIRR stuck?** → SV reads `rte_line_25.remote_irr=1`; UFS `IS_` only `utrcs=1` (no fatal). Narrowed: EOI/RIRR ordering, not UFS.
4. **What breaks the ordering?** → VISA `servicePCmdValid[3]/[0]`, `w2sbsm_ps` → **EOI prioritized over MSI completion** at P2SB. Narrowed to the P2SB bridge.
5. **Is it the known NVL bug?** → disable the NVL P2SB fix via `p2sbc.ccpeome=0x1` → **issue reproduces on NVL**. Confirmed: same P2SB posted-vs-nonposted ordering bug, fixed NVL, absent on WCL.

## 7. Root cause (precise mechanism + class)
- **Class:** `design-rtl` — a **P2SB PCIe ordering-rule implementation bug** (posted vs non-posted), found in NVL pre-si emulation, **fixed in NVL, missed in WCL/PTL**. `[confirmed: BEAT, 16025859186]`
- **Mechanism** `[confirmed: 16025859186 RTL]`: multiple `MWr`→`CRWr` toward gpcom fill the **sbep FIFO** (credit delay). ITSS sends the MSI `MWr` to P2SB to convert to a primary cycle. Before P2SB can pass the **completion** into the sbep FIFO, an **EOI** arrives from the primary cycle. `selectedPMaster` flips from **3 (MWr→CrWr) to 0 (EOI conversion)** with `servicePCmdValid` asserted, so the RTL sees `outMsgPReqValid` as continuous → the **EOI enters the FIFO ahead of the completion**.
- **System effect:** the IOAPIC's `SEND_IOAPIC_INTR` completion (which sets **RIRR=1**) is delayed; the **Directed-EOI is seen while RIRR=0 and is discarded**; the late completion then sets **RIRR=1 permanently** → the **level-triggered** UFS line (`rte_line_25`) is wedged → no further UFS interrupts → ISR never runs → 30 s StorPort timeout → reset-cascade loop → 0x9F.
- **Why UFS exposes it:** a heavy-I/O, **line-based level-triggered** device drives enough P2S sideband traffic during S4-resume/WR to hit the race. `[confirmed: Comment 1667724964]`

### 7b. Fingerprint registers (high level)
- **`rte_line_25.remote_irr = 1` (stuck)** + `delivery_status = 1`, level/active-low — the one decisive read.
- **UFS `IS_`**: only `utrcs = 1`; `SBFES`/`HCFES`/`DFES` = 0 → proves the UFS controller is healthy.
- Full bit decode → `reference/ufs-glossary.md`.

## 8. Fix & verification (or workaround + status)
- **NVL:** HW fix in P2SB (`16025859186`, complete/user_verified) — a write-ordering rule so the **EOI special-write cannot pass the MSI completion**; proven by the `p2sbc.ccpeome` chicken bit (set `0x1` → bug returns on NVL). `[confirmed]`
- **WCL / WCL-R / MNL (no HW fix — SoC BugEco `16030673570` rejected/future_product):** **OS mitigation** = Root-OS inserts an **IOAPIC `IOREGSEL` register read immediately before the EOI write**, fencing the late completion so RIRR=1 before EOI. Works for **both Hyper-V enabled and disabled** (IOAPIC is passthrough; read reaches HW with no HV intervention; no hypervisor change needed). `[confirmed: WA email, Comment 2162621274]`
  - **Iterations:** MTC kernel change (read UFS RIRR) → 6 systems, 600+ cycles clean → MSFT test kernel off **6D LCU** (reads IOREGSEL, **WA limited to WCL**) → released as **25H2'7D**. `[confirmed]`
  - **Regression from mis-scoping:** an early MSFT 24H2 backport read RIRR for **all IPs (not UFS-only)** → new failures: **IOMMU_INTERRUPT_REMAPPING_FAULT (0x1fb)** (VT-d, Arg2=0x25), `pc:Ab04` hangs, and 9F with IRP pending on `UcmUcsiAcpiClient` (a **different** USB-C/UCSI issue). → **WA must be UFS-scoped.** `[confirmed: Comment 1667578591/1363666535]`
- **Field verification:** Xiaomi P59 (UFS-only) BSOD **1/3 units → 0/3** after 7D. `[confirmed: Comment 1567187054]`
- **Alternative WA considered:** move UFS IRQ from **level → edge** trigger (UFS IP team: **no IP impact**). `[confirmed: Comment 14615454242]`
- **Long-term:** **UFS IP moves to MSI** — planned for **HammerLake** (PCR `16030590109`). `[confirmed: Comment 1667724964]`
- **Errata:** `13015782827` filed (errata_central) — write-up template still empty. `[confirmed]`

## 9. Retrospective (avoidable? prevention? detection gap?)
- **Detection gap (root):** **UFS was not in the Corp config**, so the DPMO run never hit it; enabling UFS on RVP reproduced it immediately. The issue was **Pre-Si detectable (BEAT = Yes)** and had been caught in NVL pre-si emulation. `[confirmed: BEAT]`
- **Prevention (tracked):** AR `16031730035` — **include & enable UFS in Corp config SST validation** (owner skarthik, **not_done**). Preventive scope: Platform + CVE 4/5-star. `[confirmed]`
- **Cost:** **123 days** debugging; **61 days** from first-failure to root-cause; found **Post-PRQ**, customer-reported. `[confirmed: BEAT]`
- **Dead-ends / false leads (don't repeat):** NAC-bad response; **UFS PHY equalization (−6 dB) sweep**; "driver spec-violation" doorbell-multi-write theory; the mis-scoped all-IP RIRR-read (caused IOMMU 0x1fb / `pc:Ab04`).
